title_en: Bank of Dalian Co., Ltd., Shenyang Branch v. Fushun Yanfeng Building Materials Co., Ltd. and Zheng Kexu — dispute over an outsider's objection to enforcement
ruling_gist_en: According to Article 312 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, in an action of execution objection filed by a person not a party to the case, if the court finds after trial that the person not a party to the case has a civil right or interest in the subject matter of execution sufficient to preclude enforcement, the court shall rule that the subject matter of execution shall not be enforced. In this case, the drawer of a bank acceptance deposit deposited margin into a special account for bank acceptance margin as security for the acceptance business. The nature of such act is the creation of a pledge of money. When the drawer fails to pay the matured draft, and the bank fulfills its obligation to advance payment, the bank shall have the right, based on the pledge, to obtain priority payment from the margin deposit. A pledge, being a security interest, is sufficient to preclude the compulsory enforcement of claims in another case.

full_text_en:
Dalian Bank Co., Ltd. Shenyang Branch v. Fushun Yanfeng Building Materials Co., Ltd. and Zheng Kexu — action for objection to enforcement by a third party

Ruling Summary

Article 312 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC provides that, in an action for objection to enforcement brought by a third party, if the court finds after trial that the third party enjoys a civil right and interest in the subject matter of enforcement sufficient to preclude compulsory enforcement, the court shall rule that the subject matter of enforcement shall not be enforced. In this case, the drawer of an acceptance bill deposited margin into a dedicated margin account for bank acceptance bills as security for the acceptance business. The nature of such act constitutes the creation of a pledge of cash. Where the drawer fails to pay the bill amount at maturity and the bank fulfills its obligation to advance payment, the bank, based on the pledge right, has the right to be repaid from such margin with priority. A pledge right is a security interest and is sufficient to preclude compulsory enforcement in another case.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

(2015) Min Ti Zi No. 175

Re-Applicant (plaintiff at first instance, appellant at second instance): Dalian Bank Co., Ltd. Shenyang Branch. Address: No. 1, Gate 1, No. 77-1 Beizhan Road, Shenhe District, Liaoning Province.

Person in Charge: Bi Hexuan, Branch Manager.

Agent ad litem: Xu Wenhao, employee of the branch.

Respondent (defendant at first instance, appellee at second instance): Fushun Yanfeng Building Materials Co., Ltd. Address: Room 4020, No. 2, Lishijing District Avenue, Fushun Economic Development Zone, Liaoning Province.

Legal Representative: Li Huicheng, General Manager of the company.

Respondent (defendant at first instance, appellee at second instance): Zheng Kexu, male, Han ethnicity, born December 28, 1968, residing in Bazhou, Hebei Province.

Agent ad litem: Dai Mengyong, lawyer of Beijing Zi Lue Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: He Limin, lawyer of Beijing Yifei Law Firm.

The re-applicant, Dalian Bank Co., Ltd. Shenyang Branch (hereinafter referred to as Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch), due to its dissatisfaction with the civil judgment (2014) Ji Min Er Zhong Zi No. 32 of the Hebei High People's Court in the case of an action for objection to enforcement by a third party against the respondents, Fushun Yanfeng Building Materials Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Yanfeng Company) and Zheng Kexu, applied to this Court for retrial. This Court rendered a civil ruling (2015) Min Shen Zi No. 736 on June 16, 2015, granting the retrial. This Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law, with Judge Wang Tao as presiding judge, and acting judges Mei Fang and Yang Zuo as members, and held a public hearing. The court clerk Chen Ming kept the record. Xu Wenhao, agent ad litem of Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch, and Dai Mengyong and He Limin, agents ad litem of Zheng Kexu, appeared in court. Yanfeng Company, after being legally summoned, did not appear. The trial of this case has now concluded.

The First Instance Trial by Langfang Intermediate People's Court of Hebei Province found the following facts:

On December 6, 2011, Yanfeng Company and Zheng Kexu signed a Loan Contract, stipulating: the loan amount is RMB 80,000,000; the loan date is December 6, 2011; the repayment date is December 7, 2011. On the same day, Yanfeng Company and Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch signed a Bill Acceptance Contract, stipulating: under this contract, there are a total of 8 bank acceptance bills, with an aggregate face amount of RMB 80,000,000; the drawer of all bills is Yanfeng Company; the payee of all bills is Shenyang Shouchuang Materials Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Shouchuang Company); the date of issue of all bills is December 6, 2011; the maturity date of all bills is June 6, 2012; conditions for acceptance are that the commercial transaction relationship between Yanfeng Company and the payee is genuine, lawful, and has consideration; Yanfeng Company has reliable sources of funds to pay the amount of the bills at maturity; there is no fraudulent conduct in respect of the bills; before acceptance of the bills, Yanfeng Company shall open a dedicated margin account (account number 1012 xxxxxxxxxxxx 0023) with Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch for the bills under this contract and deposit margin equal to 100% of the bill amount, the margin amount being RMB 80,000,000; Yanfeng Company agrees to use the said margin and the interest generated therefrom as security for performing this contract, and authorizes Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch to freeze, deduct, or handle the said margin as needed under this contract; rights and obligations of parties are that within one month from the date of issue of the bills under this contract, Yanfeng Company shall provide Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch with copies of the VAT invoices between it and the payee, and Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch has the right to require verification of the originals; Yanfeng Company shall deposit the full amount of the bills into the account designated by Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch before the maturity date of the bills under this contract; if Yanfeng Company fails to deliver the full amount of the bills by the maturity date, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch has the right to directly use the funds from the margin account under Article 2.2 of this contract and other deposit accounts of Yanfeng Company to pay the bills at maturity or repay Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch's advance payment to the holder and the corresponding interest and handling fees, and also impose a penalty interest of 0.5 per ten thousand per day on the unpaid bill amount; after acceptance of the bills under this contract, if any of the following circumstances occurs, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch may require Yanfeng Company to increase the margin to 100% of the bill amount: if Yanfeng Company fails to replenish the margin as required by Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch in time, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch has the right to declare Yanfeng Company in breach, initiate proceedings against Yanfeng Company, and exercise corresponding rights in accordance with the relevant security contract. On the day of signing the Bill Acceptance Contract, Yanfeng Company deposited RMB 80,000,000 into account number 1012 xxxxxxxxxxxx 0325 of the Wenyilu Sub-branch of Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch, and the Wenyilu Sub-branch transferred the RMB 80,000,000

to the margin account number 1012 xxxxxxxxxxxx 0023 designated in the Bill Acceptance Contract. On the same day, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch affixed the bill acceptance seal on the front of the 8 bank acceptance bills (each with a face amount of RMB 10,000,000, date of issue December 6, 2011, maturity June 6, 2012), under the phrase "This bill has been accepted; payment will be made by this bank at maturity", with Yanfeng Company as drawer, Shouchuang Company as payee, and the Wenyilu Sub-branch of Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch as paying bank. Thereafter, it delivered the 8 bills to the drawer, Yanfeng Company. The date of acceptance was not filled in on the bills.

Yanfeng Company did not repay on the repayment date stipulated in the Loan Contract, i.e., December 7, 2011. Thereafter, Yanfeng Company, Zheng Kexu, and a non-party, Mingda Yihang Enterprise Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Mingda Yihang Company), signed a Repayment Agreement on December 24, 2011, stipulating: Yanfeng Company borrowed RMB 80,000,000 from Zheng Kexu on December 6, 2011, for use as 100% margin for acceptance bills issued by Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch; after receiving this sum, Yanfeng Company did not repay it as agreed but instead used it for other purposes; after negotiation, the parties reached the following agreement: the principal of RMB 80,000,000 and interest of RMB 5,000,000 shall be repaid in full between January 6, 2012 and January 19, 2012. After the deadline, Yanfeng Company and Mingda Yihang Company did not perform. On April 20, 2012, Yanfeng Company, Zheng Kexu, and Mingda Yihang Company again signed a Repayment Supplementary Agreement, stipulating: the first installment shall be repaid between May 20-25, 2012, in the amount of RMB 20,000,000; the second installment shall be repaid between June 20-25, 2012, in the amount of RMB 20,000,000; the third installment shall be repaid between July 20-25, 2012, in the amount of RMB 20,000,000; the fourth installment shall be repaid between August 20-25, 2012, in the amount of RMB 20,000,000; interest shall be calculated from December 20, 2011, at a monthly interest rate of 2% based on the actual occupation time and amount, and the said interest shall be settled by the end of September 2012. After the expiration of the above contracts, Yanfeng Company and Mingda Yihang Company also failed to perform.

On May 23, 2012, Liaoning Provincial Branch of China Postal Savings Bank Co., Ltd. collected payment by means of entrusted collection for 6 of the aforementioned 8 bank acceptance bills (bill numbers 313000512063920-313000512063924 and 313000512063929). On May 25, 2012, Shenzhen Branch of China Minsheng Bank Co., Ltd. collected payment by means of entrusted collection for the remaining 2 bills (bill numbers 313000512063927, 313000512063928). On June 6, 2012, the Wenyilu Sub-branch of Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch paid the total amount of RMB 80,000,000 for the above 8 bills. On the same day, the Wenyilu Sub-branch of Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch converted the RMB 80,000,000 into overdue advance payment.

In May 2012, Zheng Kexu initiated two lawsuits against Yanfeng Company and Mingda Yihang Company in Langfang Intermediate People's Court, seeking repayment of loans of RMB 40,000,000 and interest respectively, and requesting that Mingda Yihang Company bear the guarantee liability, and also applied for property preservation. On May 28, 2012, the Langfang Intermediate People's Court ordered the freezing of margin of RMB 80,000,000 in account number 1012 xxxxxxxxxxxx 0023 of Yanfeng Company opened at the Wenyilu Sub-branch of Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch. Subsequently, the Langfang Intermediate People's Court issued civil judgments (2012) Lang Min San Chu Zi No. 117 and No. 133. Mingda Yihang Company, dissatisfied with the civil judgment (2012) Lang Min San Chu Zi No. 133, appealed to the Hebei High People's Court, which issued a civil judgment (2013) Ji Min Yi Zhong Zi No. 139 on July 3, 2013, dismissing the appeal and upholding the original judgment.

During the period when Zheng Kexu applied for the enforcement of the civil judgment (2012) Lang Min San Chu Zi No. 117, on May 14, 2013, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch filed a written objection with the Langfang Intermediate People's Court, stating: the erroneous freezing act in the enforcement case (2013) Lang Min Zhi Zi No. 26 should be corrected, and the seizure of the bank margin deposit of RMB 40,000,000 should be lifted. On August 20, 2013, the court issued an enforcement ruling (2013) Lang Zhi Yi Zi No. 26-1, holding: on May 28, 2012, the court froze the deposit in the margin account of Yanfeng Company with Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch. On June 6, 2012, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch honored the bills. The time of the court's freezing of the margin account deposit preceded the time of acceptance and payment of the bills by Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch. Pursuant to Article 9 of the Notice on Regulating the Enforcement and Financial Institutions' Assistance in Enforcement by the Supreme People's Court and the People's Bank of China (Fa Fa [2000] No. 21), a people's court may lawfully take freezing measures against bank acceptance bill margin, but shall not deduct it; if a financial institution has accepted or made external payment on the bill, the people's court shall, upon application by the financial institution, lift the freezing measures on the corresponding portion of the bank acceptance bill margin. When the bank acceptance bill margin has lost its margin function, the people's court may lawfully take deduction measures. In this case, where the court had already taken freezing measures, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch, without regard to the risks associated with the transaction in these funds and ignoring the court's freezing measures, still continued to accept and make external payment, and in this case, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch failed to consider that there might be a sham transaction contract and issues with the drawing of the bills. Therefore, the court did not support Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch's request to lift the freezing measures on the RMB 40,000,000. After the objection of Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch was dismissed, it could file an action for objection to enforcement by a third party with this court to resolve this substantive dispute. In accordance with Article 227 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC and Article 15 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Enforcement Procedures of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, the court ruled to dismiss Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch's objection.

On October 9, 2013, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch filed this action with the court of first instance against Yanfeng Company and Zheng Kexu, requesting the revocation of the enforcement ruling (2013) Lang Zhi Yi Zi No. 26-1 of the court of first instance, and confirmation that it has the right of priority to be repaid from the RMB 40,000,000 in account number 1012 xxxxxxxxxxxx 0023; and that the litigation costs be borne by Yanfeng Company and Zheng Kexu.

The court of first instance found that the issues in dispute in this case were: 1. Whether the payee's acts of entrusted collection on May 23, 2012 and May 25, 2012 constituted an act of acceptance already completed by the acceptor; 2. The nature of the margin account and whether Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch has a right of priority to be repaid from the funds in the margin account.

As to the first issue, the court held that, pursuant to Article 3, paragraph 3 of the Measures for Commercial Bills (Yin Fa [1993] No. 140, issued by the People's Bank of China on May 21, 1993), a bank acceptance bill is a bill drawn by the payee or the applicant for acceptance, applied for by the applicant for acceptance to its bank of account, and accepted by the bank after examination and approval. Article 38 of the Negotiable Instruments Law of the PRC provides that acceptance is the act of the drawee of a bill promising to pay the amount of the bill at maturity; Article 39 provides that for a bill payable at a fixed date or after a fixed period from the date of issue, the holder shall present the bill for acceptance to the drawee before the maturity date. Presentment for acceptance is the act of the holder presenting the bill to the drawee and requesting the drawee to promise payment; Article 41, paragraph 1 provides that the drawee, upon receiving a bill presented for acceptance, shall accept or refuse to accept within three days from the date of receipt; Article 42 provides that where the drawee accepts a bill, it shall record the word "accepted" and the date of acceptance on the face of the bill and affix its signature... If the date of acceptance is not recorded on the bill, the last day of the period specified in the first paragraph of the preceding article shall be deemed the date of acceptance. Article 73 of the Payment and Settlement Measures (Yin Fa [1997] No. 393, issued by the People's Bank of China on September 19, 1997) provides that commercial bills are divided into commercial acceptance bills and bank acceptance bills... Bank acceptance bills are accepted by banks; Article 79 provides that bank acceptance bills shall be drawn by a depositor who has a deposit account at the accepting bank; Article 80 provides that commercial bills may be used after being presented for acceptance to the drawee at the time of drawing, or used first after drawing and then presented for acceptance to the drawee; Article 83 provides that when the drawer or holder of a bank acceptance bill presents it for acceptance to a bank, the bank's credit department shall, in accordance with relevant provisions and approval procedures, carefully examine the drawer's qualifications, credit standing, purchase and sale contracts, and the contents recorded on the bill, and if necessary, require the drawer to provide security. If the requirements for acceptance are met, an acceptance agreement shall be signed with the drawer; Article 84 provides that when a drawee accepts a commercial bill, it shall record the word "accepted" and the date of acceptance on the face of the bill and affix its signature. From the above provisions of laws and regulations, it can be seen that, when Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch recorded "accepted" and affixed its seal on the face of the 8 bank acceptance bills (each with a face amount of RMB 10,000,000, totaling RMB 80,000,000) after signing the Bill Acceptance Contract with Yanfeng Company, Yanfeng Company's application to Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch to issue acceptance bills constituted the act of Yanfeng Company, as drawer, presenting the bills to the drawee, i.e., Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch, recorded on the bills, and requesting Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch to promise payment; that is, the act of the drawer, Yanfeng Company, presenting the bills for acceptance to the drawee, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch, at the time of drawing. After examination in accordance with relevant provisions and approval procedures, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch required the drawer Yanfeng Company to deposit RMB 80,000,000 margin in a margin account, and after signing the Bill Acceptance Contract with Yanfeng Company, affixed its seal on the 8 bank acceptance bills in the column reading "This bill has been accepted; payment will be made by this bank at maturity". This constituted the act of the drawee completing acceptance of the bank acceptance bills as provided in the Negotiable Instruments Law. This is also consistent with the provisions of Article 80 of the Payment and Settlement Measures, i.e., commercial bills may be used after being presented for acceptance to the drawee at the time of drawing. According to Article 22 of the Negotiable Instruments Law of the PRC, the affixing of an acceptance seal on the face of a bank acceptance bill is not a mandatory item to be recorded on the bill. However, according to the current use and circulation of bank acceptance bills in China, bank acceptance bills with a bank as drawee are generally usable and circulated in the market only after the drawer and the drawee have signed a bill acceptance contract and the bank has affixed its seal on the face of the bank acceptance bill in the column reading "This bill has been accepted; payment will be made by this bank at maturity". Financial personnel of the payee, as the creditor of the underlying relationship and the holder of the bill, when settling by bank acceptance bill, would not accept a bank acceptance bill on which the drawee (i.e., the bank) has not affixed a bank acceptance seal on the face. Since the payee would not accept such a bank acceptance bill, it is also impossible for it to endorse on the first endorser column on the back of the bank acceptance bill. Even if the payee endorsed the bill for transfer, the subsequent endorsee, upon seeing that there is no acceptance seal of the drawee on the face of the bank acceptance bill, would not accept such a bank acceptance bill to satisfy or extinguish the obligation of the underlying relationship. In practice, a bank acceptance bill is one where the drawer, at the same time as drawing, presents the bill to the drawee for acceptance, the drawee completes acceptance (i.e., affixes the acceptance seal on the face of the bank acceptance bill) and delivers it to the drawer, the drawer delivers it to the payee to satisfy or extinguish the underlying relationship, and after receiving the bank acceptance bill, the payee affixes its seal on the first endorser column on the back of the bank acceptance bill before the bank acceptance bill can be used and circulated normally. That is to say, at the time of drawing a bank acceptance bill, the drawee must or shall complete the act of acceptance. Article 88 of the Payment and Settlement Measures provides that the presentment period for payment of commercial bills is 10 days from the maturity date. The holder shall, within the presentment period for payment, entrust the bank of account to collect payment or directly present the bill for payment to the drawee. For off-site entrusted collection, the holder may estimate the postal journey and entrust the bank of account for collection in advance; Article 198 provides that entrusted collection is a settlement method whereby the payee entrusts a bank to collect money from the drawee; Article 199 provides that units and individuals may use the entrusted collection method for settlement based on debt instruments of the drawee such as accepted commercial bills, bonds, certificates of deposit, etc. From the above provisions, it can be seen that entrusted collection is a method of payment settlement and is an act of presentment for payment under the Negotiable Instruments Law, not, as Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch argued, the act of the acceptor completing acceptance.

Regarding the second disputed issue, the court held that Article 208 of the Property Law of the PRC provides that, for the purpose of securing the performance of an obligation, if a debtor or a third party delivers his or its movable property to the creditor for possession as a pledge, and the debtor fails to perform the obligation due or the circumstances for realizing the pledged property as agreed by the parties occur, the creditor shall be entitled to be satisfied out of the said movable property on a priority basis; Article 210 provides that, to create a pledge, the parties shall conclude a pledge contract in writing. Article 85 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Security Law of the PRC provides that, where a debtor or a third party specifically identifies his or its money by means such as a special account, sealed money, or a deposit, and then delivers it to the creditor for possession as a security for the claim, if the debtor fails to perform the obligation, the creditor may be satisfied out of the said money on a priority basis. From the relevant legal provisions, if a deposit is to be used to create a pledge in the form of a deposit, then, in accordance with Article 210 of the Property Law of the PRC, it shall be in writing. As a general trade practice, the proportion of the deposit to be paid in is generally determined by the paying bank based on the creditworthiness of the drawer of the bank acceptance bill, typically ranging from 30% to 50% of the bill amount, with a maximum of 100% and a minimum of zero. The amount of the deposit for a bank acceptance bill generally considers two aspects: first, the proportion is determined with reference to the bill amount; second, and primarily, the proportion is determined with reference to the creditworthiness of the drawer. The purpose for the bank to require the drawer to deposit a certain amount of money in a deposit account opened for it is not to use this deposit to offset the amount payable at maturity, but rather, in case the drawer fails to keep credit or is unable to repay the advance, to reduce risk by using the bank's actions (the bank's notice of freezing the deposit) to control a certain amount of the drawer's funds. From this perspective, the funds in the deposit account do not have the nature of a pledge. Article 18 of the Measures for Commercial Drafts provides that the applicant for acceptance of a bank acceptance bill shall pay the full amount of the bill into its account at the issuing bank before the maturity date of the bank acceptance bill. The accepting bank shall, on the maturity date, pay the amount to the payee, the endorse, or the discount bank upon presentation of the bill. If the drawer defaults, the bank may deduct the deposit in accordance with the bill acceptance agreement. However, if the court freezes the deposit account before the bank makes payment, the bank is not liable to the drawer for the freezing of the deposit. To continue performing the bill acceptance agreement, the bank may require the drawer to replenish the deposit before the maturity date. If the drawer fails to replenish the deposit, it is the drawer's default, and the bank may refuse to pay the holder (payee) and issue a notice of refusal to pay. The liability for breach of contract arising therefrom shall be borne by the drawer, as the drawer is the ultimate debtor. The bank may, based on the drawer's default, prepare a notice of refusal to pay and resolve the dispute through litigation to determine the destination of the deposit. If the bank has already accepted or made external payment on the bill, upon the completion of the acceptance or external payment, the bill relationship in respect of the accepted bill is extinguished, and the function of the deposit is lost accordingly. Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch and Yanfeng Company did not enter into a written pledge contract using the deposit as a pledge. After the above analysis, the nature of the deposit should be a credit guarantee. Therefore, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch's claim that the deposit constitutes a pledge of money and that it has a right to priority satisfaction cannot be upheld.

With respect to the issue of providing special value-added tax invoices and the "Industrial Products Sales Contract," the court held that Article 10 of the Negotiable Instruments Law of the PRC provides that the issuance, acquisition, and transfer of a negotiable instrument shall follow the principle of good faith and have a genuine transaction relationship and a relationship of creditor's rights and debts. Without considering the validity of the bill, based solely on the provisions of Article 5.3 of the "Bill Acceptance Contract" and the fact that the seller and buyer in the "Industrial Products Sales Contract" were reversed, there is reason to believe that the transaction relationship or the relationship of creditor's rights and debts under the 80 million yuan bank acceptance bill in this case was not genuine. Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch had fault or gross negligence in this conduct.

In summary, the collection of payment claimed by Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch did not constitute an act of acceptance as defined in the Negotiable Instruments Law, but rather an act of presenting for payment under the Negotiable Instruments Law. At the time Yanfeng Company applied for the issuance of the bank acceptance bill, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch's affixing of the acceptance special seal on the face of the bank acceptance bill constituted an act of acceptance under the Negotiable Instruments Law, meaning that at the same time the drawer issued the bill, the payee, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch, had already accepted it. Article 9 of the Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the People's Bank of China on Regulating Court Enforcement and Financial Institutions' Assistance in Enforcement provides that a people's court may lawfully take freezing measures against a deposit for a bank acceptance bill, but shall not withhold the funds. If a financial institution has accepted a bill or has made external payment, the people's court shall, upon application by the financial institution, lift the freezing measures on the corresponding part of the deposit for the bank acceptance bill. Article 39 of the Negotiable Instruments Law of the PRC provides that, for a bill payable on a fixed date, the holder shall present the bill to the payee for acceptance before the maturity date. However, according to the current general trade practice and actual operation, it is customary and necessary in China's current reality for the drawer of a bank acceptance bill to complete the act of acceptance simultaneously with the issuance of the bill, which also complies with the relevant provisions of the Negotiable Instruments Law; otherwise, the payee would not accept the bill. If, in accordance with Article 9 of the Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the People's Bank of China on Regulating Court Enforcement and Financial Institutions' Assistance in Enforcement, the provisions of this Article apply to the act of acceptance completed simultaneously with the issuance of the bill, then, since acceptance has been determined under Article 9, it would be unnecessary for a court to be able to take freezing measures under Article 9. Therefore, in this case, only the issue of whether external payment has been made can be considered. In this case, the court froze the funds first, and Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch made payment later. Article 9 of the aforesaid Notice provides that when the function of the deposit for a bank acceptance bill has been lost, the people's court may lawfully take withholding measures. The nature of a deposit account deposit is that of a credit guarantee, not the pledge of money claimed by Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch. After the court took freezing measures against the deposit, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch could require Yanfeng Company to provide other security or issue a notice of refusal to pay in accordance with the "Bill Acceptance Contract" and relevant provisions. Therefore, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch's decision to make external payment after the court freezing was its own responsibility. When Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch made external payment on the maturity date, the bill relationship for the bank acceptance bill was extinguished, and the deposit function was lost. Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch had no legal basis to enjoy a right of priority satisfaction over the deposit, and the court could withhold the funds. Therefore, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch's claims had no legal basis and were not supported by the court. In accordance with Article 64 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, the court ruled as follows: All claims of Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch are dismissed. The case acceptance fee of 120,900 yuan shall be borne by Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch.

Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch, dissatisfied with the above first-instance judgment, appealed to the Hebei High People's Court, arguing: Whether the "Industrial Products Sales Contract" under the "Bill Acceptance Contract" was genuine was not the disputed issue in this case. The first-instance court illegally examined the underlying relationship of the bill, improperly expanding the scope of review of whether acceptance or payment had occurred. By adjudicating a bill dispute and a sales contract dispute in an action for enforcement objection, the first-instance court violated procedural law. The court froze the 80 million yuan deposit before the acceptance maturity date, and the payee was also obligated to unconditionally pay at maturity. The payee could, in accordance with Article 2 of the Reply of the People's Bank of China on Freezing and Withholding of Bank Acceptance Bill Deposits (Yin Tiao Fa [2000] No. 9), apply to the people's court for priority satisfaction from the frozen deposit. The first-instance court's reasoning that the bill relationship for the bank acceptance bill was extinguished and the deposit function was lost when the paying bank made external payment on the maturity date was logically inconsistent. Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch requested the second-instance court to remand the case for retrial or amend the judgment.

The second-instance court, after trial, confirmed the facts found by the first-instance court.

The second-instance court held that, according to Articles 10 and 21(2) of the Negotiable Instruments Law of the PRC, the issuance, acquisition, and transfer of a negotiable instrument shall be based on a genuine transaction relationship, and no bill without consideration shall be issued to fraudulently obtain funds from a bank or other bill parties. Based on the evidence examined at trial, it could be determined that at the time Yanfeng Company applied to Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch for a bank acceptance bill and signed the 80 million yuan "Bill Acceptance Contract," there was no genuine transaction relationship or relationship of creditor's rights and debts between the drawer, Yanfeng Company, and the payee, Shouchuang Company, as stipulated in the contract. Under circumstances where the "Industrial Products Sales Contract" was fictitious, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch still signed the "Bill Acceptance Contract" with Yanfeng Company and issued the bank acceptance bill, which constituted gross negligence. In this case, it was a basic obligation of Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch, when Yanfeng Company applied for the issuance of the bank acceptance bill, to review the genuineness and legality of the underlying transaction relationship provided by Yanfeng Company, but Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch failed to do so. To prevent parties from using false contracts to defraud bank funds, the people's court should lawfully ascertain whether an enforcement objection raised by a third party has corresponding factual and legal basis. The people's court's review of the genuineness and legality of the underlying relationship of an acceptance bill is to uphold the basic principle of China's negotiable instrument legislation and financial regulation that "the issuance, acquisition, and transfer of a negotiable instrument shall have a genuine transaction relationship," and does not violate procedural law.

On December 6, 2011, the 80 million yuan transferred by Yanfeng Company into the deposit account in question was the 80 million yuan loan originally provided by Zheng Kexu to Yanfeng Company. According to Article 5.7 of Chapter 5 of the "Bill Acceptance Contract" between Yanfeng Company and Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch, Yanfeng Company was required to deposit the full amount of the bill into the account designated by Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch before the maturity date of the bill. When the Langfang Intermediate People's Court froze the 80 million yuan deposit on May 28, 2012, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch did not require Yanfeng Company to replenish the funds but instead paid the amount using 80 million yuan from a loan account opened by Yanfeng Company at the bank, which constituted clear fault.

In summary, when Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch signed the "Bill Acceptance Contract" with Yanfeng Company, it failed to fulfill its statutory regulatory duties, failed to review the sales contract that lacked a genuine transaction relationship, and issued a bank acceptance bill without consideration, bearing significant fault for Yanfeng Company's fraudulent acquisition of 80 million yuan in bank funds. After the Langfang Intermediate People's Court froze the 80 million yuan in the deposit account opened by Yanfeng Company at Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch did not require Yanfeng Company to deposit the full amount of the bill into the designated account before the maturity date as stipulated in Article 5.7 of Chapter 5 of the "Bill Acceptance Contract," but instead made the payment, bearing an undeniable responsibility for the resulting loss. The deposit in question pertained to contract security, which was unrelated to the acceptance or payment of the bill. The legal nature of this deposit should be determined in accordance with the "Bill Acceptance Contract." From the provisions of Article 2.2 of Chapter 2 of the "Bill Acceptance Contract" regarding the deposit, it only provided that "the Party B is authorized to handle the freezing, deduction, and other procedures for the above deposit as necessary for this contract," and did not provide that "if Party A fails to perform its obligations under this contract, Party B shall have a right of priority satisfaction over this deposit." Thus, the parties did not intend to create a pledge of money with the 80 million yuan deposit for the benefit of Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch. Therefore, the deposit did not have the nature of a pledge of money, and Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch did not enjoy a right of priority satisfaction. The appeal grounds of Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch were insufficient, and its appeal requests were not supported. The original judgment was procedurally lawful, the facts were clear, and the application of law was correct. In accordance with Article 170(1)(i) of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, the court ruled as follows: The appeal is dismissed and the original judgment is affirmed; the second-instance case acceptance fee of 120,900 yuan shall be borne by Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch.

Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch, dissatisfied with the above second-instance judgment, applied to this court for retrial, arguing: 1. The original judgment's finding that Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch failed to fulfill its statutory regulatory duties when signing the "Bill Acceptance Contract" with Yanfeng Company and issued a bank acceptance bill without consideration, bearing significant fault for Yanfeng Company's fraudulent acquisition of 80 million yuan (including 40 million yuan in this case and 40 million yuan in another case), was inconsistent with the facts. (a) Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch had fulfilled its statutory review obligations. Although the "Industrial Products Sales Contract" signed by Yanfeng Company and Shouchuang Company had issues with the affixing of seals by both parties, this was merely a formal issue with the contract and had no substantive impact on the rights and obligations under the contract itself. (b) Although Yanfeng Company did not provide copies of the special value-added tax invoices as required by the "Bill Acceptance Contract," this could not be used to deny the transaction relationship between Yanfeng Company and Shouchuang Company. (c) The original court's determination that there was no genuine transaction relationship between Yanfeng Company and Shouchuang Company without any investigation was erroneous, and moreover, this issue fell outside the scope of review in this case. 2. The original judgment's finding that Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch insisted on accepting and paying the bill even after the deposit was frozen, bearing an undeniable responsibility, was inconsistent with the law. According to the Negotiable Instruments Law of the PRC, a bank, as the payee in a bill acceptance legal relationship, has an unconditional obligation to pay the holder upon presentation or on the maturity date. Even if the deposit for the bank acceptance bill is frozen, the payee is still obligated to pay unconditionally at maturity. Chinese law does not provide that after a deposit is sealed, a bank cannot pay the holder. Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch, as the payee of the accepted bill, made the payment not in disregard of the court's sealing measure, but out of full respect for the law and the contract. 3. The original judgment's determination that Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch did not have a right of priority satisfaction over the 40 million yuan deposit in this case was an erroneous application of law. (a) According to Articles 2.2 and 5.7 of the "Bill Acceptance Contract," Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch and Yanfeng Company had reached an agreement to use the 40 million yuan in the deposit account as pledge security for this bill acceptance transaction. The original court's finding that the parties did not intend to use the deposit as a pledge of money was inconsistent with the contract. (b) In this case, the parties, in accordance with the "Bill Acceptance Contract," had opened a dedicated deposit account for the pledged money, Yanfeng Company had paid in the deposit, and Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch had frozen the deposit, satisfying the requirement of specifically identifying the pledged money in the form of a deposit. This deposit account was opened at Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch, which actually controlled and managed the account. The use of funds in the deposit account corresponded to the deposit business and was not used for daily settlement outside of the deposit business. Therefore, the requirement of delivering the pledged money to the creditor for possession was also satisfied, and the pledge of money had been established. Accordingly, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch was entitled to exercise a right of priority satisfaction over the 40 million yuan deposit in question. In summary, the original judgment erred in fact finding and improperly applied the law. Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch applied for retrial pursuant to Article 200(1), (2), and (6) of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, requesting the revocation of the civil judgment of the Hebei High People's Court (2014) Ji Min Er Zhong Zi No. 32, and either remand the case for retrial or amend the judgment.

Zheng Kexu argued in defense: 1. The original judgment correctly found that Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch had gross negligence when signing the "Bill Acceptance Contract." (a) Whether the transaction between Yanfeng Company and Shouchuang Company was genuine and lawful directly determines the legal validity of the "Bill Acceptance Contract" and the issuance and payment of the bill thereunder, and has a direct legal relationship with this case. Therefore, the original court's review of the genuineness and legality of the "Industrial Products Sales Contract" was correct. (b) Yanfeng Company's application to Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch for a bank acceptance bill and signing of the "Bill Acceptance Contract" based on a forged "Industrial Products Sales Contract" violated the Negotiable Instruments Law and other laws and regulations. Both the "Bill Acceptance Contract" and its deposit clause were invalid under the law. (c) Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch did not fulfill its review obligations with respect to Yanfeng Company's conduct of applying for a bank acceptance bill and signing the "Bill Acceptance Contract" based on the forged "Industrial Products Sales Contract," and clearly had gross negligence in Yanfeng and Shouchuang Companies' use of the false sales contract to defraud bank funds. 2. The 40 million yuan deposit in this case did not have the nature of a pledge of money, and Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch did not enjoy a right of priority satisfaction. Because the "Bill Acceptance Contract" and its deposit clause were invalid, this contract and its deposit clause could not create a pledge of money for Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch. Even leaving aside the legality and validity of the contract and its clause, their provisions did not comply with the law regarding pledge contracts and pledges of money, and could not create a pledge of money for Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch; Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch also did not enjoy a right of priority satisfaction. 3. After the court froze the 40 million yuan, regardless of whether Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch paid the accepted bill in this case, it could not oppose the court's freezing and withholding measures. In this case, the Langfang Intermediate People's Court had already lawfully frozen the 40 million yuan deposit in Yanfeng Company's deposit account on May 28, 2012. However, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch still paid 40 million yuan to the holder on June 6, 2012, without requiring Yanfeng Company, as stipulated in the contract, to "pay the full amount of the bill into its account at the issuing bank before the maturity date of the bank acceptance bill." Its conduct clearly constituted gross negligence. Therefore, Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch had no right to request the court to lift the freezing measures on the 40 million yuan deposit in this case. In summary, the original judgment found the facts clearly, the evidence was sufficient, and the application of law was correct. Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch's retrial application did not meet the statutory conditions for retrial and should be dismissed.

Yanfeng Company did not submit a defense opinion.

Upon retrial, this court confirmed the facts found by the original courts.

Opinion of the Court

In this case, the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch filed a lawsuit as an objector to enforcement challenging the enforcement objection ruling (2013) Lang Zhi Yi Zi No. 26-1 of the Langfang Intermediate People's Court of Hebei Province. Pursuant to Article 312 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, in cases of this type, after trial, a people's court shall render a decision according to the following circumstances: (1) if the objector has a civil right and interest in the subject matter of enforcement sufficient to preclude enforcement, the court shall rule that the subject matter shall not be enforced; (2) if the objector does not have a civil right and interest in the subject matter of enforcement sufficient to preclude enforcement, the court shall dismiss the claims. If the objector also requests confirmation of his right, the people's court may make a ruling on that request in the same judgment. Therefore, the focus of this retrial is whether the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch enjoys a civil right and interest in the subject matter of enforcement, i.e., the RMB 40 million deposited in the special guarantee deposit account of Yanfeng Company, sufficient to preclude compulsory enforcement by the people's court. The Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch argues that the RMB 40 million deposited in the special guarantee deposit account constitutes a guarantee deposit with the effect of a pledge of money. Upon its payment under the bank acceptance bills issued upon Yanfeng Company's application, it enjoys a priority right to be repaid from the RMB 40 million. Accordingly, this case will be analyzed and determined from the aspects of whether the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch has a pledge over the RMB 40 million and whether such right is sufficient to preclude enforcement.

I. Whether the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch has a pledge over the RMB 40 million in question

Article 210 of the Property Law of the PRC provides: "To create a pledge, the parties shall conclude a pledge contract in writing. A pledge contract generally includes the following terms: (1) the type and amount of the secured claim; (2) the time limit for the debtor to perform the obligation; (3) the name, quantity, quality, and condition of the pledged property; (4) the scope of the guarantee; (5) the time for delivery of the pledged property." Article 212 provides: "The pledge is created upon delivery of the pledged property by the pledgor to the pledgee." Article 85 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Guarantee Law of the PRC provides: "Where a debtor or a third party makes money specific by means of a special account, sealed deposit, guarantee deposit, etc., and delivers it to the creditor for possession as a guarantee for the claim, and the debtor fails to perform the obligation, the creditor may claim priority in satisfaction from the money." According to the above laws and judicial interpretations, money, as a special type of movable property, may be used as pledge after meeting certain formal requirements. Specifically in this case, whether the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch has a pledge over the RMB 40 million in question should be examined from two aspects: whether there exists a pledge contract between the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch and Yanfeng Company, and whether the pledge has been validly created.

(A) Whether there exists a pledge contract between the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch and Yanfeng Company. Article 2.2 of the Bill Acceptance Contract concluded between the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch and Yanfeng Company stipulates: Before acceptance of the bill, Yanfeng Company shall open a special guarantee deposit account (account number: 1012xxxxxx0023) with the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch for the bill under the contract and deposit a guarantee deposit equal to 100% of the bill amount, the total guarantee deposit being RMB 80 million. Yanfeng Company agrees to use the said guarantee deposit and any interest accrued thereon as a guarantee for the performance of the contract, and authorizes the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch to handle procedures such as freezing, deduction, and transfer of the said guarantee deposit as needed under the contract. Article 5.7 provides: Yanfeng Company shall deposit the full amount of the bill into the account designated by the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch before the maturity date of the bill under the contract. If Yanfeng Company fails to deliver the full bill amount on or before the maturity date, the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch has the right to directly use the funds in the guarantee deposit account under Article 2.2 of the contract and in other deposit accounts of Yanfeng Company to pay the matured bill or to repay the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch's advance payment to the holder, along with corresponding interest and handling fees, and simultaneously impose a penalty interest of 0.05% per day on the unpaid bill amount. The above stipulations indicate that the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch and Yanfeng Company reached a consensus as follows: Yanfeng Company will deposit a 100% guarantee deposit as security for the acceptance bill transaction in question; if Yanfeng Company fails to deliver the full bill amount on or before the maturity date, the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch has the right to directly use the guarantee deposit to pay the matured accepted bill or to repay its advance to the holder, i.e., the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch enjoys a priority right to be repaid from the guarantee deposit in question. The above consensus meets the general requirements of a pledge contract and complies with Article 85 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Guarantee Law of the PRC regarding the pledge of money. The original trial court's determination that the parties did not have the intent to create a pledge with the guarantee deposit and that the guarantee deposit did not have the nature of a money pledge, merely because the Bill Acceptance Contract did not contain a statement that the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch has a priority right to be repaid from the guarantee deposit, was improper. This court corrects that error.

(B) Whether the pledge in this case has been validly created. According to Article 212 of the Property Law of the PRC, "The pledge is created upon delivery of the pledged property by the pledgor to the pledgee," delivery is deemed the condition for the creation of a pledge over movable property. As a special type of pledge over movable property, the pledge of money, pursuant to Article 85 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Guarantee Law of the PRC, requires both the specific identification of money and the transfer of possession to the creditor. Specifically in this case: First, the RMB 40 million in question has been specifically identified by being deposited into a special guarantee deposit account. The substantive significance of specificity of a guarantee deposit is to separate a specific amount of money from the pledgor's other property, making it an independent existence, so that it is not mixed with the pledgor's other property, and so that the money, after transfer of possession, is also independent from the pledgee's property, preventing a specific amount of money from being mixed with the general property of the pledgee or pledgor due to the characteristic that possession equates to ownership. Specifically regarding the identification of the guarantee deposit account, it requires that the account be distinguished from the pledgor's general settlement account, so that the funds in the account are independent from the pledgor's other property. In this case, the parties, as agreed in the Bill Acceptance Contract, opened the special guarantee deposit account numbered 1012xxxxxx0023, the use of which is related to guarantee deposits, different from Yanfeng Company's general settlement account numbered 1012xxxxxx0325 with the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch. Yanfeng Company deposited the guarantee deposit into the account at the ratio agreed in the Bill Acceptance Contract, and the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch issued a Notice of Freezing of Guarantee Deposit to Yanfeng Company, freezing the guarantee deposit account. Therefore, this case meets the requirement of identifying money in the form of a guarantee deposit. Second, the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch is able to exercise actual control and management over the special guarantee deposit account, achieving a transfer of possession. In this case, the special guarantee deposit account in question was opened with a sub-branch of the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch. After Yanfeng Company deposited the guarantee deposit as agreed in the Bill Acceptance Contract, the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch froze the account, so that Yanfeng Company, as the owner of the funds in the guarantee deposit account, could not freely use the funds in the account, effectively losing control and management rights over the guarantee deposit account. Furthermore, pursuant to Article 5.7 of the Bill Acceptance Contract, in the event that Yanfeng Company fails to deliver the full bill amount on or before the maturity date, the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch has the right to directly use the funds in the guarantee deposit account to pay the matured bill or to repay its advance to the holder, that is, the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch has the right to directly deduct funds from the special guarantee deposit account. Therefore, it should be determined that the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch has effectively obtained control over the special guarantee deposit account in question, and such transfer of control meets the substantive requirements for delivery and possession of movable property.

Based on the comprehensive analysis above, it can be determined that a pledge of money has been created in this case, and the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch enjoys a pledge over the RMB 40 million guarantee deposit in question. The Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch's claims and reasons in this retrial are supported by facts and law, and this court upholds them. The original trial court's determination that the deposit in the guarantee deposit account in this case constituted a credit guarantee and not a money pledge was an error in the application of law, which this court corrects.

II. Whether the pledge held by the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch over the RMB 40 million guarantee deposit in question is sufficient to preclude the compulsory enforcement in the loan case between Zheng Kexu and Yanfeng Company

According to Article 170 of the Property Law of the PRC, where the debtor fails to perform an obligation that is due or where the parties agree on circumstances for realizing the security interest, the holder of a security interest is entitled to priority in satisfaction from the secured property as provided by law. Article 208 provides: To secure performance of an obligation, if the debtor or a third party pledges his movable property to the creditor for possession, and the debtor fails to perform an obligation that is due or where the parties agree on circumstances for realizing the pledge, the creditor is entitled to priority in satisfaction from the said movable property. Therefore, after the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch fulfilled its payment obligation under the bill acceptance in question, it obtained a claim for advance payment against Yanfeng Company, i.e., the secured claim under the Bill Acceptance Contract has arisen. To realize this claim, the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch is entitled to claim priority in satisfaction against the RMB 40 million guarantee deposit. However, the particularity of this case is that in another case, the loan contract dispute between Zheng Kexu and Yanfeng Company and Mingda Yihang Company, the court ruled that Zheng Kexu holds a claim against Yanfeng Company for RMB 40 million principal plus corresponding interest. In the enforcement of that case, the RMB 40 million, as Yanfeng Company's funds, was frozen by the Langfang Intermediate People's Court. Therefore, a conflict arises between the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch's claim of a pledge over the same subject of enforcement, the RMB 40 million guarantee deposit in question, and Zheng Kexu's claim of an ordinary debt. Whether the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch's pledge can preclude the compulsory enforcement in the Zheng Kexu case is the ultimate issue to be resolved in this case, and that issue depends on the relationship between property rights and claims.

In terms of the nature and classification of rights, the pledge held by the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch over Yanfeng Company is a security interest, and therefore has the basic characteristics and legal effects of a property right. Article 2, paragraph 3, of the Property Law of the PRC clearly provides: "Property rights as referred to in this Law mean the rights of the obligee to directly dominate and exclude others with respect to specific things according to law." Accordingly, property rights take precedence over claims, meaning that when a claim and a property right conflict over the same subject matter, the property right prevails over the claim. Specifically in this case, the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch holds a security interest over the RMB 40 million guarantee deposit in question, while Zheng Kexu, as an ordinary creditor of Yanfeng Company, holds only a general claim against Yanfeng Company's deposits. Although both rights are lawful civil rights of the parties, in comparison, the property right held by the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch should take priority over the ordinary claim of Zheng Kexu. Therefore, it can be concluded that the pledge held by the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch over the subject matter of enforcement, i.e., the RMB 40 million guarantee deposit, is sufficient to preclude the compulsory enforcement in the loan case between Zheng Kexu and Yanfeng Company. The Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch's claims in this retrial are supported by facts and law, and this court upholds them. The original trial court's determination that the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch does not have a priority right to be repaid from the RMB 40 million guarantee deposit was an error in the application of law, which this court corrects.

Regarding Zheng Kexu's argument in his defense that the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch was grossly negligent in the process of issuing the bill, based on the facts of this case, the Bill Acceptance Contract between the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch and Yanfeng Company reflects the true intent of both parties. There is no evidence to show that the contract falls under any of the circumstances of contract invalidity as provided in Article 52 of the Contract Law of the PRC. Therefore, the parties have formed a negotiable instrument legal relationship. The Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch conducted a corresponding formal review of the Industrial and Mineral Products Sales Contract provided by Yanfeng Company. Although the failure to require Yanfeng Company to provide copies of special VAT invoices, as required by the Bill Acceptance Contract, indicates a less-than-standard business practice, it does not affect the authenticity, legality, or validity of the Bill Acceptance Contract or the negotiable instrument legal relationship. As for the underlying transaction relationship between Yanfeng Company and Shouchuang Company, this pertains to the causal relationship for obtaining the negotiable instrument. A negotiable instrument, as a formal security, is characterized by its literal nature and independence. Once the instrument relationship is established, it is detached from the causal relationship for obtaining the instrument. Whether the causal relationship exists or is valid does not affect the validity of the instrument itself. Therefore, Zheng Kexu, as a person who is not a party to the instrument legal relationship, argues that the Bill Acceptance Contract and its guarantee deposit clause are invalid on the ground that the sales transaction relationship between Yanfeng Company and Shouchuang Company is false. This argument has no legal basis, and this court does not accept it.

Furthermore, Zheng Kexu also argues that the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch was also at fault during the process of paying the bill, and that it should not have made payment after the Langfang Intermediate People's Court had frozen the guarantee deposit in question. However, based on the facts of this case, at the time of issuing the bill, the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch stamped the bill acceptance seal on the face of the bill where it states "This bill has been accepted, and the Bank will pay on the maturity date," i.e., it accepted the bill. Once the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch accepted the bill, it became obligated to pay the bill amount unconditionally at maturity, and it has actually fulfilled that payment obligation. Pursuant to Article 9 of the Notice on Regulating the Assistance of Financial Institutions in Enforcement by People's Courts According to Law (Fa Fa [2000] No. 21) jointly issued by the Supreme People's Court and the People's Bank of China, which provides: "People's courts may freeze bank acceptance bill guarantee deposits according to law, but shall not deduct them. If the financial institution has already accepted the bill or has paid externally, upon the financial institution's application, the people's court shall release the freeze on the corresponding portion of the bank acceptance bill guarantee deposit; when the bank acceptance bill guarantee deposit loses its guarantee function, the people's court may deduct it according to law." Although the Langfang Intermediate People's Court froze the guarantee deposit in question on May 28, 2013, that freeze occurred after the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch's acceptance. And when Yanfeng Company failed to deposit the full bill amount by the maturity date, the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch had already actually fulfilled its payment obligation, forming a creditor-debtor relationship of advance payment with Yanfeng Company. At that time, the RMB 40 million guarantee deposit in question had not lost its guarantee function. Therefore, the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch is entitled to object to the freeze measures taken by the Langfang Intermediate People's Court, and that court should release the freeze on the corresponding portion of the guarantee deposit. The original trial court's finding that the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch was clearly at fault for paying the bill without requiring Yanfeng Company to deposit the bill amount into the designated account before the maturity date after the court froze the RMB 40 million guarantee deposit, and that the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch should bear its own losses, has no legal basis, and this court corrects that finding.

Additionally, the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch also has a claim in this case to revoke the enforcement objection ruling (2013) Lang Zhi Yi Zi No. 26-1 of the Langfang Intermediate People's Court. However, pursuant to Article 314 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, which provides: "In a lawsuit of objection to enforcement by an objector, if the people's court rules that the subject matter of enforcement shall not be enforced, the enforcement objection ruling becomes invalid," once this court rules that the subject matter of enforcement, the RMB 40 million guarantee deposit in question, shall not be enforced, the said enforcement objection ruling will be invalidated. Therefore, the Dalian Bank Shenyang Branch's claim on this point has become moot.

In conclusion, pursuant to Article 2, paragraph 3, Article 170, Article 208, Article 210, and Article 212 of the Property Law of the PRC, Article 85 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Guarantee Law of the PRC, Article 207 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, Article 312 and Article 407, paragraph 2 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, this court renders the following judgment:

1. The civil judgment (2013) Lang Min San Chu Zi No. 123 of the Langfang Intermediate People's Court of Hebei Province is reversed.

2. The civil judgment (2014) Ji Min Er Zhong Zi No. 32 of the Hebei High People's Court is reversed.

3. The RMB 40 million guarantee deposit in the special guarantee deposit account (account number: 1012xxxxxx0023) of Fushun Yanfeng Building Materials Co., Ltd. shall not be enforced.

4. The Dalian Bank Co., Ltd. Shenyang Branch enjoys a pledge over the said RMB 40 million guarantee deposit and may be repaid in priority.

The court acceptance fees for the first and second instances, each RMB 120,900, shall be borne by Zheng Kexu.

This judgment is final.
